subject: Money
title: Closing the Mental Account
description: A 60-second lesson on Closing the Mental Account.

hook.text: Selling a stock at a loss hurts. But once sold, relief floods in. The mental account is finally closed.

buildup.text: Open mental accounts create psychological tension. Unresolved financial decisions nag at you.

discovery.text: Paying off a small debt feels disproportionately good. It closes an account. The relief exceeds the math.

twist.text: The debt snowball method works psychologically, not mathematically. Close small debts first for momentum.

climax.text: Financial peace isn't just about numbers. It's about how many open accounts weigh on your mind.

punchline.text: Close the account. Free the mind.

quiz.question: Why does the debt snowball method work?
options: Closing small debts creates psychological momentum
